project_name: Santa Fe v1 — Depósito de Gás
audience: Housewives ordering via smartphone (Mobile-First, large buttons, minimal friction).

headings.instruction: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Apply tracking-tight for all headings > 24px. Do NOT use Inter for headings.

body.instruction: Use for body text, inputs, labels, and small text. Prioritize readability. Minimum body size 16px (text-base) for accessibility.

typography.hierarchy_rules: No jump between heading and subheading should exceed 2 Tailwind scale steps. H1 max is text-4xl on mobile, text-5xl on desktop.

primary.description: Vivid Blue - represents water, trust, and cleanliness.

secondary.description: Energetic Orange - used strictly for high-conversion CTAs (e.g., Pedir no WhatsApp). Do not overuse.

rules: Never use pure black or pure white except for primary text/background.
Orange (#f97316) is ONLY for primary actions ('Pedir', 'Confirmar').
Blue (#0284c7) is for trust elements (App bar, Meus Pedidos, active states).
Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text. Use APCA guidelines.

layouts.mobile_first: The entire application must be constrained to a mobile-like container (max-w-md mx-auto) on desktop to simulate the PWA experience natively.
layouts.spacing: Use generous spacing. Tailwind scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Cards must have at least p-6. No cramped elements.
layouts.header: Solid background (bg-white or bg-primary). NEVER transparent. Must have a bottom border or shadow.
layouts.bottom_navigation: Use a sticky bottom bar for the 'Resumo / Continuar' action in the order flow.
layouts.grids: Use 1-column layouts primarily for mobile. Product cards can be 2-col on larger screens, but stack on small mobile screens.

buttons.size: Massive touch targets. Default height h-14 (56px). text-lg font-bold.
buttons.motion: Add active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform for tactile feedback.
buttons.states: Clearly define hover, active, and disabled states.

cards.surface: Solid background, 1px subtle border (border-border), soft shadow (shadow-sm). No heavy drop shadows.

inputs.labels: Clear, placed above the input. Bold or semi-bold (font-medium text-foreground).

rules: Micro-animations on all interactive elements (hover, focus, active).
Do NOT use 'transition-all'. Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Stagger list items slightly on entrance.

accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='order-button-gas', data-testid='input-cep').
accessibility.forms: Use appropriate HTML5 input types (tel, number, text). CEP input must trigger numeric keypad on mobile.

gas_cylinder.description: Propane tank/Gas cylinder image for the P13 product card.

mineral_water.description: Clear plastic bottles with blue caps representing 20L mineral water gallons.

rules: Use object-cover for all product images to ensure they fill their container neatly.
Image constraints: Product images should be large and appetizing/clear, max-h-[200px] on cards.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for clean, consistent UI iconography. Large stroke-width (2px or 2.5px) for friendliness.
visual_enhancers.badges: Use soft backgrounds (e.g., bg-orange-100 text-orange-700) for labels like 'Promoção' or 'Desconto'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a clean, mobile-first PWA structure. Center the app container on desktop (e.g., max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen border-x bg-white).
Keep the user flow extremely linear: Home (Products) -> Select Quantity -> Checkout Form -> WhatsApp Redirect.
Implement the ViaCEP integration for the 'CEP' field to auto-fill Address, Neighborhood, and City.
Do NOT force users to log in on the first purchase. Make 'Login com Google' a prominent but optional button in the menu or post-purchase.
Fidelity program: Visually represent the '10 orders -> 11th free/discounted' as a progress bar or stamp card in the 'Meus Pedidos' area.
Add a banner for 'Loja Fechada' (Store Closed) if the current time is outside operating hours (handled by admin settings).
Block orders (disable submit) if the returned ViaCEP city is not 'João Pessoa'.
Admin Panel should be a protected route (/admin) validating against a whitelist of emails.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their border-radii (make them rounder) and heights to match the mobile-first requirement.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., Address found, CEP invalid).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in a way that disrupts the human natural reading flow of text. Use max-w-md mx-auto for the layout constraint, but text should be left-aligned mostly.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
